caption: Hold it longer with this cue. #Core #Fitness

beats.shot: side view of Lina on her forearms
beats.does: holds a forearm plank with her hips sagging low toward the floor
beats.says: Let your hips drop toward the floor.

beats.does: arches her lower back even more
beats.says: Arching your lower back works your core harder.

beats.does: holds the sagging position, face calm
beats.says: Hold it like this for as long as you can.
The lower the hips, the better.
Try it for one minute tonight.
